pr_body:
The TPCC large schema benchmark intentionally used transactions for batching DDL operations because of the large number of objects that needed to be created by this test. When
autocommit_before_ddl enabled this test started timing out because just creating the tables can now take a long time. To address this, this patch disables autocommit_before_ddl for the test.

Fixes: #141572

Release note: None
